title: Adams & Green 1993 AF hydration after testing

quantity.name: hydration
quantity.definition: weight of water / dry weight of annulus sample after testing

source.sample: 11 vertical lateral-annulus slices (5 mm thick, ~30 mm wide, bone-AF-bone) from 6 cadaveric lumbar spines

protocol.summary: Vertical slices of outer lateral annulus with bone ends potted in dental stone (outer surface not trimmed, lamellae continuous bone to bone); slicing under PEG/0.15 M NaCl spray (no swelling), surfaces covered in Clingfilm; vertical tension to ~70% of estimated UTS with 2.0 s linear ramp load/unload cycles; stiffness = gradient of linear region at 70% EUTS (also 35% EUTS); then sequential vertical cuts (1, 3, 7) reducing effective width 30 -> 15 -> 7.5 -> 3.75 mm.
how_to_simulate: Compare model AF water content (as water/dry weight)

extraction.check_notes: 12 samples from Parts I and II.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
